title: Template validate & diff-core
description: How to use pnpm template:validate and pnpm template:diff-core — when to run them, what they check, and scenario examples.

blocks.title: Why these commands exist
blocks.text: Templates are standalone projects copied once from packages/core. You edit templates/<name>/ directly most days. These two commands help before release: validate catches broken Prisma/TypeScript/ESLint, and diff-core shows exactly what would change if you propagate a core fix.
Command reference

rows: Detailed report: matches / differs / missing vs packages/core, plus template-only files
Same for all templates listed in templates.json
Skip auto-install if node_modules is missing

blocks.text: Both commands accept a template id (hotel) or directory name (hotel-website-template). Resolution reads templates.json — you do not need to cd into the template folder.
pnpm template:diff-core exits with code 1 if propagate would change files (differs or missing core paths). This matches the idea behind pnpm sync-templates:check, but with a richer per-file report.
pnpm template:diff-core
What it does
Compares templates/<directory>/ against packages/core for every path that sync-templates would overwrite. It does not write anything.

items: Lists files under packages/core (excluding scaffold/, scripts/dev/, node_modules, and maintainer-only files like core README)
Hashes each core file and the matching path in the template
Rebuilds the expected prisma/schema.prisma from core schema + template prisma/domain.prisma and compares to the template’s merged schema
Lists template-only files (pages, domain features, seeds, assets) that sync would never touch

blocks.text: Report categories

rows: Template file is byte-identical to packages/core — propagate would not change it
Template diverged from core — pnpm sync-templates would overwrite this path
Core has a file the template lacks — sync would add it
Exists only in the template — sync ignores these (your Hero, domain CRUD, domain.prisma, etc.)

blocks.text: When to use

items: Before pnpm sync-templates — see which files would be overwritten
After editing packages/core — confirm hotel and real-estate still align or need propagate
After accidentally editing a core-owned file in a template (e.g. auth.ts) — see if you should revert locally or propagate from core
In CI — fail the job if templates drift from core without an intentional propagate

blocks.text: Scenario examples

blocks.title: Scenario A — You fixed a lead API bug in core
blocks.text: You edited packages/core/lib/features/leads/lead.service.ts. Run pnpm template:diff-core hotel. You expect ≠ lib/features/leads/lead.service.ts (template still has old code). Run pnpm sync-templates --template hotel-website-template, then pnpm template:diff-core hotel again — should show 0 differs.

blocks.title: Scenario B — Normal hotel feature work
blocks.text: You only changed templates/hotel-website-template/app/components/Hero.tsx. Run pnpm template:diff-core hotel. Core paths should still match (✓ 59 matches, 0 differs). Template-only list includes Hero.tsx — that is expected.

blocks.title: Scenario C — Template customized a core file on purpose
blocks.text: Hotel admin tweaked Navbar.tsx in the template folder. diff-core shows ≠ app/components/Navbar.tsx. sync-templates would wipe that customization. Either move the change into packages/core (if all templates need it) or revert the template copy and keep the override only in the template — do not run sync blindly.

blocks.code:
pnpm template:diff-core hotel

# Example output (abbreviated):
# hotel → templates/hotel-website-template
#   ✓ matches core:     59
#   ≠ differs from core: 0
#   − missing in template: 0
#   + template-only:    75

blocks.text: pnpm template:validate
What it does
Runs a three-step quality gate inside templates/<directory>/ from the monorepo root:

items: Install — if node_modules is missing, runs pnpm install in the template folder (skipped with --skip-install)
prisma validate — checks prisma/schema.prisma syntax and generator/datasource config via prisma.config.ts
tsc --noEmit — full TypeScript check with the template tsconfig (paths, strict mode, Next.js types)
pnpm lint — ESLint via the template’s package.json lint script

blocks.text: If any step fails, the command stops and reports which template failed. Exit code 1 on failure.
When to use

items: Before tempjs version inc — catch type errors and invalid Prisma before shipping
After changing prisma/domain.prisma — ensure merged schema still validates
After adding API routes or admin components — TypeScript catches bad imports and props
After pnpm new-template — confirm the scaffolded template builds cleanly
Locally before opening a PR — same checks you want in future CI

blocks.text: Scenario examples

blocks.title: Scenario D — Release hotel 1.4.0
blocks.text: pnpm template:validate hotel → tempjs version check → edit CHANGELOG → tempjs version inc minor hotel. Validate first so you do not bump a broken template.

blocks.title: Scenario E — New domain model
blocks.text: You added Review to prisma/domain.prisma and new lib/features/reviews/. Run pnpm template:validate hotel. Prisma validate fails if domain.prisma has syntax errors; tsc fails if repository types do not match the Prisma client.

blocks.title: Scenario F — CI or offline machine
blocks.text: Deps already installed in templates/hotel-website-template/node_modules. Use pnpm template:validate hotel --skip-install to avoid network and speed up the run.

blocks.code:
pnpm template:validate hotel
pnpm template:validate              # all templates in templates.json
pnpm template:validate hotel --skip-install

blocks.text: How they relate to sync-templates

rows: Detailed preview before propagate; lists template-only files
Apply core files into template folders
Quality gate — unrelated to core drift

blocks.text: Typical core-fix workflow: edit packages/core → template:diff-core hotel → sync-templates --template hotel-website-template → template:validate hotel → version bump.
Implementation (scripts)

items: scripts/template-cli-utils.mjs — resolves hotel or hotel-website-template via templates.json
scripts/template-diff-core.mjs — uses template-core-utils.mjs (listCoreFiles, buildMergedPrismaSchema)
scripts/template-validate.mjs — spawnSync pnpm exec prisma validate, tsc, lint in template cwd
